issues.description: getCategoryLabel complects label rendering with heuristic guessing instead of an explicit data mapping.
issues.detail: The old adapter held an explicit CATEGORY_LABELS table — a value, not a guess. The new lib/categories.ts replaces that with a heuristic (short words = acronym, regex for vN suffix, plus an empty SPECIAL_CASES escape hatch). That's EASY-NOT-SIMPLE: a function pretending to know what the data means. Keep the explicit map; use heuristics only as a fallback.

issues.description: selectedPoint conflates 'highlighted category on radar' with 'selected detail panel point'.
issues.detail: One identity (selectedPoint) is now driven both by clicking a radar dot and by the dropdown selection, and is also read as 'is anything faded'. That is three concerns on one ref: selection, highlight, and detail focus. COMPLECTED — separate selectedCategoryId (a value, optionally null) from detailPoint, and derive radar fading from the former.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER gains a duplicate 'Info' key mapping to the same rank as 'Informational' without a single source of truth.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 papers over an upstream naming inconsistency inside the constants table. That is PLACE-ORIENTED thinking — fixing the symptom where it shows. Normalize severity names at the data boundary (one canonical value) instead of carrying two aliases in the ordering map forever.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the row map; pull it out as a value above the loop.
issues.detail: maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) is computed once per row inside .map. It is a property of the dataset, not of the row — a value that belongs in the outer scope. Compute once, pass in. Small, but exactly the kind of complecting-of-scope that compounds.

issues.description: CategorySelector uses sentinel string 'all' to mean null, complecting the empty case with a real value.
issues.detail: handleValueChange treats '' or 'all' as null, and value={selectedCategory ?? 'all'} encodes the null back into a string. That's three representations of 'no selection' (null, '', 'all') flowing through one component. Pick one model at the boundary — null for absence — and stop translating.

issues.description: Rename ThreatScore -> Prowler ThreatScore is a branding decision threaded through code, not data.
issues.detail: The label 'Prowler ThreatScore' is now hard-coded in at least five places across risk-plot-client and threat-score components. That's incidental coupling of branding to UI code. The question that should have been asked first: where does the product name live as a single value, so the next rename is one edit?

review.summary: The diff does useful decomposition (extracting categories into lib/categories.ts, sharing a labelFormatter, generalizing the bar-width math), but it trades an explicit data table for heuristics and introduces several small complections worth naming. The radar view now overloads one selectedPoint identity with three roles (selection, highlight, detail focus). The category selector translates null through two sentinel strings. SEVERITY_ORDER gains an alias instead of normalizing at the boundary. None are blockers; all are EASY-NOT-SIMPLE patterns where a small refactor makes the values, identities, and time semantics obvious. The right move before the next feature: keep the explicit category map as the value, derive labels from it, and separate selection-id from detail-point.
